settings.title: House menu
settings.intro: Find something you fancy. I'll make it.

cocktails.name: Midori Sour
cocktails.description: A bright melon sour with fresh lime and a soft egg-white foam.
cocktails.recipe: Combine all ingredients in a shaker. Dry shake without ice, then add ice and shake again. Strain into a chilled coupe.
cocktails.imageAlt: Midori Sour served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.description: Bourbon with a little sugar and aromatic bitters, served over fresh ice.
ingredients: Orange or lemon twist, to garnish
cocktails.recipe: Combine the bourbon, syrup and bitters in a mixing glass. Stir with ice for 20–30 seconds. Strain over fresh ice into an old-fashioned glass. Garnish with an orange or lemon twist.
cocktails.imageAlt: Old Fashioned served in an old-fashioned glass

cocktails.name: Mint Julep
cocktails.description: Bourbon, mint and a touch of sugar over a mound of crushed ice.
cocktails.recipe: Add the mint and simple syrup to an old-fashioned glass and muddle gently. Add the bourbon and half-fill with pebble or crushed ice. Stir until well chilled, then top with more ice. Garnish with a mint sprig.
cocktails.imageAlt: Mint Julep served in an old-fashioned glass

cocktails.name: Hugo Spritz
cocktails.description: A light, sparkling mix of elderflower, prosecco and soda with fresh mint.
cocktails.recipe: Gently muddle the mint in a highball glass. Add the elderflower liqueur, then fill with ice. Top with the prosecco and soda water. Garnish with a lemon wheel and the mint sprig.
cocktails.imageAlt: Hugo Spritz served in a highball glass

cocktails.name: Whiskey Smash
cocktails.description: A bourbon sour brightened with lemon and gently muddled mint.
ingredients: Lemon wedge and mint sprig, to garnish
cocktails.recipe: Gently muddle the mint with the measured lemon juice in a shaker. Add the bourbon and simple syrup. Shake with ice for 10–12 seconds. Double-strain over fresh ice into an old-fashioned glass. Garnish with a lemon wedge and mint sprig.
cocktails.imageAlt: Whiskey Smash served in an old-fashioned glass

source.name: Cocktails by Steve
source.note: The source lists 22.5 ml lemon juice but mentions lemon wedges in its method. This version uses the listed juice quantity.

cocktails.name: Godfather
cocktails.description: Scotch and amaretto stirred over ice. A short, almond-sweet drink.
cocktails.recipe: Pour the Scotch and amaretto into an old-fashioned glass. Add ice, preferably one large cube, and stir briefly to chill. Garnish with an orange twist.
cocktails.imageAlt: Godfather served in an old-fashioned glass

cocktails.name: Pantheon
cocktails.description: Scotch meets herbal Bénédictine and fresh lemon in a short, shaken cocktail.
cocktails.recipe: Combine all ingredients in a shaker. Shake with ice for 10–12 seconds. Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
cocktails.imageAlt: Pantheon served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Espresso Martini
cocktails.description: Vodka, coffee liqueur and espresso shaken into a rich drink with a crema top.
cocktails.recipe: Combine the vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso and syrup in a shaker. Shake with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with three coffee beans.
cocktails.imageAlt: Espresso Martini served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Kentucky Maid
cocktails.description: Bourbon with lime, cucumber and mint. Fresh and citrusy over ice.
ingredients: Cucumber wheel and mint sprig, to garnish
cocktails.recipe: Add the mint and cucumber to a shaker and muddle gently. Add the bourbon, lime juice and syrup. Shake with ice for 10–12 seconds. Double-strain over fresh ice into an old-fashioned glass. Garnish with a cucumber wheel and mint sprig.
cocktails.imageAlt: Kentucky Maid served in an old-fashioned glass

cocktails.name: Southside
cocktails.description: A crisp gin sour with lemon and fresh mint, served straight up.
cocktails.recipe: Add all ingredients to a shaker. Shake with ice for 10–12 seconds. Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
cocktails.imageAlt: Southside served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Whiskey Sour
cocktails.description: Bourbon and lemon softened with sugar and egg-white foam, finished with bitters.
cocktails.recipe: Add the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and egg white to a shaker. Dry shake without ice. Add ice and shake again. Double-strain into a chilled coupe and finish with the aromatic bitters on the foam.
cocktails.imageAlt: Whiskey Sour served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Elder Fashioned
cocktails.description: An Old Fashioned variation with elderflower liqueur and orange bitters.
cocktails.recipe: Combine the bourbon, elderflower liqueur, syrup and bitters in a mixing glass. Stir with ice for about 30 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube into an old-fashioned glass. Garnish with an orange twist.
cocktails.imageAlt: Elder Fashioned served in an old-fashioned glass

cocktails.name: Death & Taxes
cocktails.description: A stirred mix of Scotch, gin, sweet vermouth and Bénédictine with two kinds of bitters.
cocktails.recipe: Add all liquid ingredients to a mixing glass. Stir with ice until chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.
cocktails.imageAlt: Death & Taxes served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Don Lockwood
cocktails.description: Bourbon and Islay whisky with maple syrup, chocolate bitters and aromatic bitters.
ingredients: 2 dashes Steve the Bartender chocolate bitters
cocktails.recipe: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass. Stir with ice until chilled. Strain over ice into an old-fashioned glass.
cocktails.imageAlt: Don Lockwood served in an old-fashioned glass

cocktails.name: Bee's Knees
cocktails.description: Gin, lemon and honey syrup in a bright, softly sweet sour.
cocktails.recipe: Add all ingredients to a shaker. Shake with ice for 10–12 seconds. Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
cocktails.imageAlt: Bee's Knees served in a coupe glass

cocktails.name: Kentucky Buck
cocktails.description: Bourbon and spicy ginger beer over muddled strawberry, with lemon and a little aromatic bitters.
cocktails.recipe: Gently muddle the hulled strawberry in the bottom of a highball glass. Add the bourbon, lemon juice and bitters, then fill with ice. Top with ginger beer and stir gently, keeping some strawberry at the bottom. Garnish with a fresh strawberry.
cocktails.imageAlt: Kentucky Buck in a highball with muddled strawberry at the bottom, ice and a strawberry garnish

source.name: Maker's Mark
source.note: House variation requested by the host: build in the serving glass and retain the muddled strawberry at the bottom instead of shaking and straining it.

cocktails.name: Cosmopolitan
cocktails.description: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and fresh lime. A crisp pink cocktail served straight up.
cocktails.recipe: Add the vodka, orange liqueur, lime juice and cranberry juice to a shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lemon twist.
cocktails.imageAlt: A rose-pink Cosmopolitan in a coupe with a lemon twist

source.name: International Bartenders Association
source.note: IBA quantities, served in the host’s coupe. Plain vodka and triple sec are allowed as house substitutions for citrus vodka and Cointreau.

cocktails.name: Screwdriver
cocktails.description: Vodka and orange juice over ice. Simple, fruity and easy to sip.
cocktails.recipe: Fill a highball glass with ice. Add the vodka and orange juice, then stir gently to combine. Garnish with an orange wedge.
cocktails.imageAlt: A bright orange Screwdriver in a highball with ice and an orange wedge

cocktails.name: Whiskey Coke
cocktails.description: Whiskey and Coca-Cola over plenty of ice. A familiar, easygoing highball.
cocktails.recipe: Fill a highball glass with ice. Pour in the whiskey, then add the Coca-Cola. Stir gently once or twice to mix without losing the fizz.
cocktails.imageAlt: Whiskey and cola in a highball glass with clear ice cubes

cocktails.name: Negroni
cocktails.description: Equal parts gin, vermouth and Campari. Bold, bittersweet, and made for slow sipping.
cocktails.recipe: Stir the gin, Campari and vermouth with ice until cold. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass. Express an orange peel over the glass, then add it as a garnish.
cocktails.imageAlt: A ruby-red Negroni over ice with orange peel

cocktails.name: Margarita
cocktails.description: Tequila, fresh lime and orange liqueur. A crisp, citrusy classic with a little salt on the rim.
cocktails.recipe: Rub lime around half the rim of a coupe and dip it in salt. Shake the tequila, lime juice and triple sec with ice. Fine-strain into the chilled glass and garnish with lime.
cocktails.imageAlt: A pale lime Margarita in a salt-rimmed coupe
